reading.title: A Bad Day at Work
reading.text: Chloe had a very bad day at work yesterday. First, she was late because her bus was late. When she arrived, she had too much work to do. Her colleague, Mark, was in a bad mood and did not speak to her. Then her computer crashed and she lost her documents. She went to use the photocopier, but it was out of order. At lunch time she wanted a coffee, but the coffee machine was not working. At the end of the day she tidied her desk and went home. She had a long bath and a good dinner. Today is a new day and she feels much better.

reading.title: Problems in Our World
reading.text: Our world has many problems. Some are natural. A hurricane is a very strong wind and it can destroy houses. An earthquake happens when the earth moves, and floods can cover whole towns. Other problems are made by people. Many cities are too crowded and the traffic jams are terrible in the rush hour. Air pollution is very bad in some places and some rivers are polluted, so fish die. Millions of people are poor, hungry or homeless. Some people are unemployed. Wars make life very hard. We must work together to help the people who need it and to protect our planet.

reading.title: A Busy Saturday
reading.text: On Saturday I have a lot to do. In the morning I have a shower and have breakfast with my family. At ten o'clock I have a lesson at the swimming pool. After the lesson we have a swim and then have lunch. In the afternoon I have to do my homework. I also have to tidy my room. In the evening my cousin has a party. I have got a present for her. We always have a good time at her parties. I come home late and I am very tired, but I have had a wonderful day.

reading.title: Where Do They Go?
reading.text: My family likes to go out. Every winter my father goes skiing in the mountains. My mother usually goes shopping on Saturday, but I hate going shopping. I prefer to go swimming. Last summer we went to Italy by plane. We went sightseeing in Rome and went up the stairs of an old tower. In the evening we went dancing in the hotel. Next summer we are going to visit my aunt in Canada. We are going to go there by plane again. I am very excited. I am going to take lots of photos.

reading.title: What Do You Do?
reading.text: My name is Aziza and I am a student. My mother is a teacher and my father is a doctor. What does your family do? On weekdays I do my homework after school. On Saturday morning we all do the housework. My father does the gardening and my mother does the washing. I do the washing-up after lunch. In the afternoon I usually do nothing. I just relax and listen to music. Last Saturday I did some exercises in the park. I did not do my English homework, so I did it on Sunday evening. I always try to do my best.
